N23812964.raw_response: {"core_themes": "This folder contains U.S. diplomatic reporting on elections for provincial, state, and municipal offices in Brazil, including certified state election results, party competition, and the political consequences of local voting. The records’ subject falls under POL 18-1; elections in which state or local officials sought national office are classified separately under POL 14.
